command:
set -euo pipefail
WORK=/tmp/f2-live-voice-test
rm -rf "$WORK"
git clone -q --branch chatgpt-live-emotion-20260912 --single-branch https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity.git "$WORK"
cd "$WORK"
python3 tests/test_chatgpt_live_voice_expression.py
python3 tests/test_chatgpt_live_voice_state_adapter.py
python3 -m py_compile research_entity/coordination/chatgpt_live_voice_expression.py research_entity/coordination/chatgpt_live_voice_state_adapter.py
git diff --check
printf '%s\n' '=== HEAD ==='
git rev-parse HEAD
printf '%s\n' '=== HASHES ==='
sha256sum research_entity/coordination/chatgpt_live_voice_expression.py research_entity/coordination/chatgpt_live_voice_state_adapter.py
